posts.content: Jellyfish: An end-to-end production workspace for AI-generated short dramas. From script input to structured storyboarding, consistency management, shot preparation, video generation, and export.

ai.title: Jellyfish: End-to-end AI short drama production workspace from script to export
ai.workflow_stage: concept / ideation | layout / composition | rendering / export | handoff / production
ai.summary: An end-to-end workspace specifically designed for AI-generated short dramas. Handles complete pipeline from script input through structured storyboarding, character consistency management, shot preparation, to final video generation and export.
ai.why_important: Addresses the critical production challenge of maintaining character and shot consistency across AI-generated narrative video content.
ai.learnings: Demonstrates a structured approach to AI video production that separates script parsing, storyboard structuring, consistency management, and rendering into discrete pipeline stages.

posts.content: Pallaidium: PALLAIDIUM — a generative AI movie studio, seamlessly integrated into the Blender Video Editor (VSE), enabling end-to-end production from script to screen and back.

ai.title: PALLAIDIUM: Generative AI movie studio integrated into Blender Video Editor
ai.workflow_stage: concept / ideation | asset creation | layout / composition | rendering / export | iteration / refinement
ai.summary: A generative AI movie studio seamlessly integrated into Blender's Video Sequence Editor (VSE). Enables complete production workflow from script development to final rendering within the Blender environment.
ai.why_important: Bridges the gap between traditional video editing workflows in Blender and generative AI capabilities, allowing editors to stay in their familiar toolset.
ai.learnings: Shows how generative AI can be embedded into existing professional video editing software rather than requiring separate standalone tools.

posts.content: CozyClay: Open source previs software in the browser: block a scene, pose characters, author camera moves and cuts, then take the same shots to an AI video model.

ai.title: CozyClay: Browser-based previs tool for blocking scenes and syncing to AI video models
ai.summary: Open source browser-based previsualization software for blocking scenes, posing characters, and authoring camera moves and cuts. Designed to export the same shots directly to AI video generation models.
ai.why_important: Solves the critical handoff problem between traditional previs blocking and AI video generation by maintaining shot specifications across both stages.
ai.learnings: Demonstrates how traditional previs workflows can be designed specifically to output structured data compatible with AI video model inputs.

posts.content: gsap-skills: Official AI skills for GSAP. These skills teach AI coding agents how to correctly use GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), including best practices, common animation patterns, and plugin usage.

ai.title: GSAP AI Skills: Teaching AI coding agents correct GSAP animation patterns
ai.summary: Official AI skills repository from GreenSock that teaches AI coding agents how to correctly implement GSAP animations. Includes best practices, common animation patterns, and proper plugin usage.
ai.why_important: Addresses the quality gap when AI agents generate animation code by providing authoritative pattern libraries directly from the framework creators.
ai.learnings: Shows how animation framework vendors can create structured knowledge bases that improve AI-generated animation code quality and adherence to best practices.
